seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms as freelance couriers in Hallia, investigating a web of Ugathul monsters, the Embercall company, and Grayson's necromantic manor beneath the city. Their bounty hunt for Tywelwyn Leatherhide ends in catastrophe — a total party kill at the Crowded Flea.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: After the TPK, Johnny and Benny navigate the afterlife void and meet the entity Aut, who resurrects them at a cost. With new ally Sir Arctos, the party kills Hlarf and Tywelwyn, uncovers a conspiracy of six gods using radar dishes to crack the firmament, and learns from Anaïs about the cosmic Narrative.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: The party attends a mysterious pilgrimage gathering at an abandoned mining town, surviving a deadly gladiatorial trial and solving puzzles to gather keystone clues. They trade a stolen painting to a Heart for a keystone, fight off a Concordia ambush, and secure passage aboard the colossal Strider.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: Argyle mysteriously returns — only half alive — as the party enters an extended downtime, then discovers a hairline crack in reality beneath Teller's Run revealing an imprisoned god and a vast conspiracy. They bomb the research facility, collapse Teller's Run, and prepare for the Strider's departure.

seasons.title: Aboard the Strider
seasons.arc_summary: The party boards the colossal Strider, creates their heart 'Eerie,' and builds alliances with rival factions while surviving deadly weekly tithes. They explore the Undercroft, forge an alliance with the ancient Machine God, and assault the Sleeping Clan — all as the cosmic Narrative's five siblings begin watching.

seasons.title: Far Starward
seasons.arc_summary: After Argyle accidentally destroys the Menhir with a god-killing gun, the Strider is flung to a dead world far starward. The party rallies surviving factions, frees Egan from the Herald's song, pursues Anzu's sister Galzu through a surreal Fane, and explores a crashed alien ship — culminating in a confrontation with the Thessian Gremory.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: Three Actinium Convox operatives — Banyan, Giancarlo Santucci, and Crindle Vilksnake — are tasked with deploying the "Midnight Sun" bomb in a Raelion Fane atop a ley line. They infiltrate the city of Orilon via river and sewer, find the bone-tree heart of the Fane, and in a desperate combat activate the monolith just before its countdown completes — obliterating all of Raelion. The session is set 20 years before the main campaign.

seasons.title: The Heist and the Forge
seasons.arc_summary: The party kidnaps Yudan from the Leviathan, learns the plan to defeat the Feep via ascension, and enters Oresk's bleak underground. After surviving an anticyclic lava ruin, they discover the Forge of Haron Sil and plead their case before the Narrative to forge a godpiercer needle from Holy Gold.

seasons.title: The Longest Night
seasons.arc_summary: Exposed to every enemy on Althane by Insuperlex, the party flees through the Oreskian tundra to Sarengrad and infiltrates the First House research facility RC3 — battling Rampart, looting the vault, and confronting Karkov to steal the Divinity Leech gun.

seasons.title: Chrome Dreams
seasons.arc_summary: The Broker whisks the party to the cyberpunk sphere of Syrin, where they navigate MediaCon, acquire cybernetic implants, and infiltrate Omnivox's orbital Golden Spire — culminating in a climactic multi-phase battle that kills the god-wannabe Immix.

seasons.title: The Fall of Mr. Feep
seasons.arc_summary: Absorbing Immix's divinity, the party strikes a bargain with the Watchers to learn Vesper Feep's true name and origin, then pins him to the weave with the golden needle and kills him in a brutal fight — before turning their attention to the 13th Realm and the Deep looming at the Lighthouse's door.

seasons.title: The Shaping
seasons.arc_summary: The party tours the 13th Realm's reincarnation machinery, endures six spire trials in the alien City in Yellow that reshape them as worthy Thessians, and fights the campaign's final battle against the Deep as the moon crashes into Althane — followed by an epilogue in which the Weft consolidates power and broadcasts their victory across the world.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A Die Hard–style holiday one-shot set in Calaria's capital, Halnia. Hildebrandt Corporation employees Atsuki, Mika Buzzle, Vint, and Chris Gangle attend a Bright Souls Eve party at headquarters, only for a terrorist named Naren Rodder to seize the building. After clearing the ballroom of captors and discovering Director of Strategy Vitor Frey is a traitor, the team climbs to the vault floor and engages Naren—who is blessed by the Heir of the Plague—in a desperate fight that ends with the Plague Codex launched out a blown-out wall into the unknown.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: Into the Joker World
seasons.arc_summary: A Cagley Middle one-shot concludes as four 8th-grade heroes slay the shadow-demon Terror of Cagley, after which the show pivots to Josh's Scale campaign: four high-ranking operatives investigate a slip-shielded structure on a shattered Joker World, battle through the fiend-built Quorum, and ultimately free Voice of Many — a divine heart trapped behind a bloodfall portal — before teleporting safely home.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: A Sedecium fire team investigates an unpowered orbital station half-sunk in the slip, uncovering evidence that the Thessian Esoterica (formerly Gremory) tortured the station's AI and accessed observatory records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job: Stealing from a Dead God
seasons.arc_summary: Pulled from retirement for a desperate raid, the team boards the Sundom planet-killer Heavy Hand of God to steal divine essence from the freshly-killed Thessian Tithe before the God Eater Harrow finishes devouring it — navigating slip puzzles and spider temples to become the only fire team to succeed.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: When a goblin intern at Bisney & Dixar Animated Studios connects a new arcane intelligence to the studio's databases, the AI overloads and casts a spell that engulfs Los Diablos in a blackout and creates a 'movie' on the island of Afro-China. Three Disney villains — Hades, Fulton (Gaston's legally distinct cousin), and Runway Brian (a forgotten Disney short mouse) — are chosen by a mandrill statue of Zeus to recover an enchanted mirror stolen by Maui, now hidden in an Elephant Graveyard of Wonders. After surviving a wildebeest stampede, solving the Cave of Wonders' riddle, defeating the hybrid genie Jaskar (Jafar-Scar fusion), and wishing themselves past a whole skipped sequence to the final soundstage, the trio battles the Legally Distinct Nostalgia Hydra — a five-headed amalgamation of iconic Disney characters that undergoes a terrifying live-action reboot mid-fight. They slay it, seize the mirror, and dive through it into the real world.
